description: This file is a C header (.h) file defining interfaces for configuring Energy Efficient Ethernet (EEE) features on RTL8367C switches. It declares function prototypes for setting and getting EEE status on network ports, defines a macro for the PHY address, and includes licensing and metadata comments.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicEee100M
methods.description: Sets the EEE (Energy Efficient Ethernet) status for 100M ports.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicEee100M
methods.description: Retrieves the EEE status for 100M ports.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicEeeGiga
methods.description: Sets the EEE status for gigabit ports.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicEeeGiga
methods.description: Retrieves the EEE status for gigabit ports.
